components.lockedText: It's locked. Maybe I should look around down here first.
Not yet. I have to find Murphy.

components.text: A shield with a whirl... it was always here.
The Sacred Heart. The lamp under it is still lit... who keeps it burning?
Every day crossed off... up to the thirteenth. The fourteenth is circled. After that, nothing.
Hawthorn. Nobody brings hawthorn into a house... Mam always said that.
A saucer of milk... it's fresh. Who left this here?
Murphy drew this. Me, him... and someone between us. Why did he scribble out the face?
